name: Enhanced Heatsink
effect: 1/scene, when you would take any amount of Heat, you may activate this system to take half instead. You take the remaining Heat at the start of your next turn.

name: Blackglass Armor Plating
effect: When you Brace, destroy this system to ignore the 1/scene limit. When you lose a Structure, automatically repair this system. This system is not a valid target for destruction otherwise.
